# Pinned verifier keys

The SHA-256 digest of every verifier key this repository derives: one per batch size from 2 to 64 windows, then the membership key. Keys are derived locally from the circuit shapes and never read from a receipt, so what a verifier accepts is decided by the circuit code it was built from. These digests are the same table the devices repository pins in `witness-prover/tests/keys.rs`, at the commit this repository was extracted from, and the same ones the Witness verify page compares against.

CI runs `cargo run --release --example vk_digests` and requires its output to match the block below line for line. A change to a circuit, or to how vega-prover derives keys from it, changes a digest and fails that check. Such a change is a change to what verifies: review it, bump the receipt or membership version, and record the new digests here and wherever Witness pins them.

To reproduce:

```bash
cargo run --release --example vk_digests
```
